summary: Adds lens-style glow around bright image regions using preprocess, bloom-radius, threshold, fill, and intensity controls.

key_params.name: preblacklevel
key_params.note: Preprocess black-level control before bloom extraction

key_params.name: output
key_params.note: Output stage: input, preprocess, bloom, bloom with alpha, or input plus bloom

key_params.name: inputimage0
key_params.note: Optional input image reference for the bloom pipeline

common_gotchas: Preview Preprocess when bright areas do not bloom as expected.
If Max Bloom Radius is below Min Bloom Radius, the effective max is forced up to the min.
Tune Fill and Intensity before fine-tuning threshold, radius, and S-curve.
Use Bloom with Alpha when the glow should be composited separately.
key_concepts: Bloom TOP isolates bright regions and builds a glow from downscaled blur levels.
Preprocess controls shape which pixels become bloom sources before the blur stage.
Minimum and maximum bloom radius select the blur-level range used for the final glow.
Threshold, S-curve, fill, and intensity tune how much glow appears and how it blends.
Output modes expose Input, Preprocess, Bloom, Bloom with Alpha, and Input plus Bloom for debugging or compositing.
Bloom with Alpha can be composited separately with Add TOP.
